project_type: Turborepo monorepo (npm workspaces): Fastify + TypeScript API (apps/api), Prisma/Postgres DB package (packages/db), shared Zod/constants package (packages/shared), Next.js web (apps/web, not touched this task). Windows/PowerShell dev host.
build_system: npm workspaces + Turborepo. QUIRK: @campusgate/shared resolves at RUNTIME to ./dist/index.js (its package.json exports.import = ./dist/index.js) while its types point at ./src/index.ts, so any new export in packages/shared/src MUST be compiled with `npm run build --workspace @campusgate/shared` (tsc) BEFORE apps/api (tsx/node) or the seed (tsx) can import it at runtime. @campusgate/db and @campusgate/api consume .ts directly. Prisma CLI pinned at 6.19.3 — DO NOT upgrade to the 8.x RC the deploy log advertises.
test_framework: vitest (apps/api only). apps/api/vitest.config.ts include = ['src/**/*.test.ts','src/**/*.property.test.ts'], environment node. packages/db and packages/shared have NO test runner today. The live cross-tenant escape suite (apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts) runs under the SAME `vitest run` and hits the REAL Supabase DB.
build_command: Root: `npm run build` (turbo build). Per package: `npm run build --workspace @campusgate/shared` (tsc), `npm run build --workspace @campusgate/api` (prisma generate + tsc). Prisma client: `npm run db:generate` (root) or `npx prisma generate` from packages/db.
test_command: `npm test --workspace @campusgate/api` (= vitest run, includes the live escape suite). Single file: from apps/api run `npx vitest run <relative-path>`.
verification_instructions: 1) `npm run build --workspace @campusgate/shared` after editing packages/shared. 2) `npx prisma validate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma` + `npx prisma generate` (from packages/db) after schema edits. 3) Author migration from packages/db: `npx prisma migrate dev --name identity_rbac_b2 --create-only`, replace generated SQL with the hand-authored script, then `npx prisma migrate dev` (or `migrate deploy`) against live Supabase; `npx prisma migrate status` confirms applied. 4) Seed: `npx tsx src/seed.ts` from packages/db (run twice to prove idempotency). 5) `npm run build --workspace @campusgate/api` typecheck. 6) `npm test --workspace @campusgate/api` for unit + integration incl. live escape suite. 7) LIVE smoke: start API (`npm run dev --workspace @campusgate/api`) and exercise login + a migrated route per role.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client is generated (not committed to source, lives in node_modules/@prisma/client); regenerate with `npx prisma generate` from packages/db after any schema.prisma change. Migrations are committed under packages/db/prisma/migrations/. No other generated-then-committed artifacts.
environment_constraints: AUTH-CRITICAL work on `main`, NO worktree — the app must stay buildable/working at every step via the compatibility shim. NEVER push to remote and never deploy — the user pushes to GitHub themselves (Railway/Vercel auto-deploy on their push). Migrations execute as `postgres` via DIRECT_URL (session pooler 5432); runtime tenant client is `campass_app` via DATABASE_URL (6543, pgbouncer=true); privileged client is PRIVILEGED_DATABASE_URL (postgres 6543, falls back DIRECT_URL→DATABASE_URL). .env files already configured in packages/db/.env and apps/api/.env (DO NOT echo secret values). KNOWN ISSUE: local network to Supabase ap-south-1 is slow (5-12s) and occasionally P1001 — retry, do not treat as failure; the escape harness already has withRetry. B-1 migration 20261018110658_tenancy_isolation_rls is FROZEN — never edit. campass_app is NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS — never grant BYPASSRLS. Package manager is npm, NOT pnpm (the design text's `pnpm --filter` is wrong for this repo).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering exists at repo root; README documents npm workspace + turbo conventions. Scope is identity-rbac.md §3–§8 only — NOT §9 deferred items: no multi-institution UX, no self-service role editing, no module-entitlement/activation tables, MFA fields modelled only (not wired), canOnResource documented-only (not exported), legacy `role` claim kept. Every tenant-owned table gets institutionId + composite FKs + RLS ENABLE+FORCE + both fail-closed policies + escape-suite RLS_TABLES coverage, all in the SAME migration (tenancy.md §8 / database.md §4 rule). Role is NOT RLS in Phase 0 (all templates have institutionId=null). The authoritative SQL/decisions live in c:/campusgate/.agents/tasks/identity-rbac-design.md — follow it exactly where it is more specific than a doc.
key_patterns: B-1 migration order is the template: (1) add institutionId NULLABLE, (2) backfill, (2b) `DO $$ ... RAISE EXCEPTION` null guard, (3) SET NOT NULL, (4) (id,institutionId) composite uniques on parents, (5) composite FKs `ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE` (one B-1 FK uses SET NULL — do NOT copy that for the new departmentScope FK, use RESTRICT + MATCH SIMPLE), (6) `DO $$ FOREACH t IN ARRAY[...]` RLS ENABLE+FORCE + tenant_isolation_select (USING institutionId = current_setting('app.current_institution_id', true)) + tenant_isolation_modify (USING + WITH CHECK), (7) idempotent GRANT block `DO $$ IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='campass_app')`. Existing parent uniques to target: users_id_institutionId_key, departments_id_institutionId_key (both from B-1). Route guards: each GatePass route file has EXACTLY ONE top-level `app.addHook("preHandler", requireTenantRole("<ROLE>"))` (platform.ts → requireSuperAdmin(); notifications.ts → bare authenticate). requireTenantRole/requireRole/requireSuperAdmin each call authenticate() INTERNALLY — so flipping means REPLACING the role hook with a bare `authenticate` hook + per-route requirePermission(key) (requirePermission must NOT re-authenticate). Tenant reads go through withTenant(institutionId, tx) (a standalone exported fn in packages/db/src/index.ts, no request access); auth-bootstrap/platform reads go through privilegedPrisma (RLS-bypass). Record-level scope stays in handlers via getStudentInTenant/getHodInTenant/getGuardInTenant.
